# ionhour_project (Resource)

An Ionhour project: the container for checks and jobs.

Deleting a project that still has active checks or jobs fails with `PROJECT_NOT_EMPTY`; the API never cascades, so a project replacement cannot wipe monitors created in the dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ionhour_project" "payments" {
  name        = "Payments"
  description = "Checkout, billing and payout monitors"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Project name (1-255 characters).

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-text description. Removing it clears the stored value.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339, UTC).
- `id` (Number) Numeric project id.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339, UTC).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a project by its numeric id.
terraform import ionhour_project.payments 7
```
